about.heading: About QR Code Generator
about.text: QR Code Generator builds what a QR code should hold from simple fields — a web link, text, an email, a phone number, an SMS, Wi-Fi login details, a vCard 3.0 contact or a map location — and draws it with your colors, square, rounded or dot modules, an error-correction level and an optional logo. The PNG is 200 to 2000 pixels wide; SVG and PDF are vector. Before the downloads appear, the PNG drawing is decoded with jsQR and must give back exactly the content built from your fields. Codes are static, with no redirect, expiry or scan counting, and your Wi-Fi password or contact details stay on the page that drew them.

example.heading: Example
example.text: What the code holds for two sets of fields (the page's own buildPayload function, run in Node on October 6, 2026). You fill in Wi-Fi — Network name (SSID): Cafe Wi-Fi Password: tea;time Security: WPA / WPA2 / WPA3 URL — Web address: example.com/menu Text inside the QR code WIFI:T:WPA;S:Cafe Wi-Fi;P:tea\;time;; https://example.com/menu

howto: Pick what the code should hold — "URL", "Wi-Fi", "Contact (vCard)", "Location" or one of the four other types — and fill in its fields.
Under "Design", set "Code colour", "Background", the "Shape" and the "Error correction" level, and move the "PNG size" slider.
Optionally click "Add a logo (optional)" and choose a PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or SVG image of up to 2 MB.
Click "Generate QR Code"; once "Scanned back successfully" appears, use "Download" for PNG, SVG or PDF, or "Download all" for a ZIP of the three.
howtoHeading: How to create a QR code

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Content types URL, text, email with subject and message, phone, SMS, Wi-Fi (WPA, WEP or open, hidden networks too), vCard 3.0 contact, map location Output formats PNG from 200 to 2000 pixels wide; SVG; PDF on a 4-inch square page Logo PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or SVG up to 2 MB; it switches error correction to High and covers at most 22 % of the code width In the PDF Rounded modules are drawn as squares, and a logo is embedded as a PNG of at most 512 px

Where your QR code is made.heading: Where your QR code is made
Where your QR code is made.text: The content is encoded by the qrcode library, drawn and checked with jsQR in your browser, and the PDF is written by pdf-lib on the page. Your text, your Wi-Fi password and your logo are not uploaded. If an error message is shown, its text, which never contains your content, is sent cleaned to our error log with the tool's name and your browser's name and major version.

faq.q: Do these QR codes expire?
faq.a: No. The content is written into the code itself, with no redirect through our site, so the code works as long as it can be read. The other side of that: you cannot change where it points later, you make a new code instead.

faq.q: Can I add a logo without breaking the code?
faq.a: Yes. A logo switches error correction to High and sits on a plain pad in the center, at most 22 % of the code width. If the drawing no longer decodes, the page offers no file and asks for a simpler or smaller logo, or none.

faq.q: Can I make a white QR code on a black background?
faq.a: No. The page accepts only a code darker than its background, with a contrast of at least 3:1; light-on-dark codes and colors that are too close are refused before drawing. Swap the two colors, or pick a darker code color.

faq.q: Can I print the QR code large?
faq.a: Yes. Download the SVG or the PDF: their modules are vector shapes that stay sharp at any size. A logo inside stays the image you gave, and the PDF holds a copy of at most 512 px, so start from a large logo for posters.

faq.q: Is my Wi-Fi password stored?
faq.a: No. The password is written into the code as plain WIFI: text and nowhere else; the page does not send it or keep it once you leave. Anyone who scans the printed code can read the password, so print it only where guests should have it.

tips: Keep the blank border of four modules around the code when you place it on a design; readers need it to find the code.

title: QR Code Scanner — Camera, Photo or Screenshot; Barcodes Too
desc: Read a QR code with your camera, or QR codes and barcodes from a photo or a pasted screenshot, up to 20 in one picture, read on your device.
ui: QR Code Scanner Scan QR codes with your camera, or QR codes and barcodes from an image Scan with camera Upload an image Paste image Click, drop or paste (Ctrl+V) a QR code image here

about.heading: About QR Code Scanner
about.text: QR Code Scanner reads codes in three ways: live from your phone or laptop camera, from a picture you upload or drop, or from a screenshot you paste. The camera reads QR codes with jsQR. A picture goes to zxing-cpp first, which also finds barcodes such as EAN-13, UPC, Code 128, Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec, up to 20 in one image, then to jsQR if nothing was found. The decoded text appears with a Copy button, and web addresses get an Open link button. Pictures and camera frames are decoded in your browser.

howto: Click "Scan with camera" and allow the camera; scanning stops by itself once a QR code is read, and "Camera" switches lenses when you have several.
Or click "Upload an image", drop a picture on the dashed box, or press Ctrl+V to paste a screenshot.
On a phone, copy the picture (in Photos: Share, then Copy), then tap "Paste image" or long-press the paste box and choose Paste.
Read the text, pick another code if several were found, then use "Copy" or "Open link".
howtoHeading: How to scan a QR code from the camera or a picture

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Image input Any picture your browser can open (image/*); pictures above 12 megapixels are reduced to 12 before reading Formats read in pictures QR Code, Micro QR, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF, Codabar and the other formats of zxing-cpp Codes per picture Up to 20, each listed with its format Live camera QR codes only, about ten reads a second; needs an https page and your permission Time limit zxing-cpp gives up after 20 seconds, then jsQR tries the picture

Where your image is processed.heading: Where your image is processed
Where your image is processed.text: Pictures and camera frames are decoded on your device, by zxing-cpp, a WebAssembly file served from this site, and by jsQR; no image, frame or decoded text is uploaded. When a camera, clipboard or picture error is shown, its message, cleaned of names and long numbers, is sent to our error log with the tool's name and your browser's name and major version.

faq.q: Can it read barcodes, not only QR codes?
faq.a: Yes, from a picture: EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, ITF, Codabar, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec and Micro QR among others, up to 20 in one image, each shown with its format. The live camera reads QR codes only.

faq.q: Can I scan without giving camera access?
faq.a: Yes. Upload, drop or paste a photo or a screenshot instead. The camera needs a secure https page and your permission; when access is refused, no camera is found or another app is using it, the page says which and suggests a photo.

faq.q: Can it read a light code on a dark background?
faq.a: Yes. Pictures are also tried with their colors inverted, and the camera reader tries every frame both as it is and inverted, so white codes on black screens or dark labels are found too.

faq.q: Is it safe to open the link from a QR code?
faq.a: No, not blindly: a code can hide a harmful address. The page shows the full text first, offers "Open link" only for http and https addresses, and opens it in a new tab without telling that site which page sent you.

tips: If a large photo fails, crop tightly around the code: a picture above 12 megapixels is reduced before reading, which shrinks a small code with it.
To make a code of your own, use the QR Code Generator for QR codes or the Barcode Generator for EAN, UPC and the other types.

title: ASCII Art Generator — Text to FIGlet Banners in 10 Fonts
desc: Type up to 60 characters and turn them into a FIGlet banner in Standard, Slant, Big, Block, ANSI Shadow or five other fonts. Copy it or save a .txt file.
ui: ASCII Art Generator Convert text to ASCII art Standard Big Slant Small Banner Block Doom Shadow ANSI Shadow 3-D Generate

about.heading: About ASCII Art Generator
about.text: ASCII Art Generator draws a word or a short phrase as a large text banner in the FIGlet format, using the figlet library by Patrick Gillespie, the author of patorjk.com. You type up to 60 characters on one line, choose one of ten fonts, and get plain text to paste into a README, a code comment or a terminal greeting. When the chosen font lacks a character, a note names it instead of dropping it silently. It draws text only, not pictures, and it all happens in your browser.

example.heading: Example
example.text: The text Hi! in the Standard font, exactly as the tool returns it. It lines up only in a monospaced font. Text (Font: Standard) Hi! Result _ _ _ _ | | | (_) | | |_| | | | | _ | |_| |_| |_|_(_)

howto: Type your text in the box; it takes up to 60 characters on one line.
Pick a font in the "Font" dropdown: Standard, Big, Slant, Small, Banner, Block, Doom, Shadow, ANSI Shadow or 3-D.
Click "Generate"; if the font lacks a character, a note above the button starts with "Not in this font, left out".
Click "Copy" to paste the banner where a monospaced font is used, or "Download" to save it as ascii-art.txt.
howtoHeading: How to make ASCII art from text

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Input Text typed on one line, up to 60 characters Fonts Standard, Big, Slant, Small, Banner, Block, Doom, Shadow, ANSI Shadow, 3-D Accented letters Standard: the French, German, Spanish, Portuguese and Scandinavian accented letters we tried, Ÿ and œ included; Big, Slant, Small, Block, Shadow: the same except œ, Œ and Ÿ; Banner, Doom: only Ä Ö Ü ä ö ü ß; ANSI Shadow, 3-D: none ANSI Shadow Capitals only, drawn with Unicode block characters such as █ and ╗, and it lacks nine punctuation signs, among them + = { } and ~ Output A multi-line text banner; Copy, or Download as ascii-art.txt

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: The banner is drawn by JavaScript running in this page. Each of the ten fonts is a file of this site, fetched the first time you generate with it; your text is not part of that request and is never sent anywhere. If copying to the clipboard fails, our error log receives the message "Copy to the clipboard failed." with the tool name and your browser's name and version, never your text.

faq.q: Does every font support accented letters?
faq.a: No. Standard draws every French, German, Spanish, Portuguese and Scandinavian accented letter we tried; Big, Slant, Small, Block and Shadow lack œ, Œ and Ÿ; Banner and Doom have just the German Ä, Ö, Ü, ä, ö, ü and ß; ANSI Shadow and 3-D have none. Any character the font lacks is named above the Generate button.

faq.q: Will the banner line up in an email or a Word document?
faq.a: No, not in a proportional font such as Arial or Calibri, where letters have different widths. Paste it into a code block, a terminal, or text set in Courier, Consolas or Menlo. ANSI Shadow also needs a font that has Unicode block characters.

faq.q: Can I make the banner narrower?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a narrower font or shorten the text, since every character widens each line. In our test on the words HELLO WORLD, Small gave the narrowest banner of the ten fonts, and Block and 3-D the widest.

tips: In a Markdown README, put the banner between two lines of three backticks so it keeps its spacing.

title: Case Converter — Sentence, Title, camelCase, snake_case
desc: Change text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, iNVERSE or five programming cases such as camelCase, line by line, in your browser.
ui: Case Converter Convert text to 12 letter and programming cases UPPERCASE lowercase Title Case Capitalized Case Sentence case aLtErNaTe iNVERSE camelCase PascalCase snake_case kebab-case CONSTANT_CASE Clear Copy

about.heading: About Case Converter
about.text: Case Converter rewrites the text in its box in one of twelve letter cases: UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Capitalized Case, Sentence case, aLtErNaTe, iNVERSE, and the programming cases camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and CONSTANT_CASE. Use it to fix text typed with caps lock on, format headings, or name variables and files. Each button converts the text in place, with no undo. It does not recognize proper nouns, so Sentence case writes friday rather than Friday. Nothing leaves the page: your browser applies its own Unicode letter rules.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Title Case on a heading typed in capitals: short words stay lower-case and NASA is kept as an acronym. Text THE LORD OF THE RINGS: A NASA REVIEW After "Title Case" The Lord of the Rings: A NASA Review

howto: Paste the text to fix, for example a heading typed with caps lock on.
Click a case button, for example "Sentence case", "Title Case" or "snake_case"; the box is rewritten at once.
To try another case on the original wording, paste it again, since each button converts what the box holds now.
Copy the converted text with "Copy", or keep it as converted.txt with "Download".
howtoHeading: How to change text case

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Input Typed or pasted text Text cases UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Capitalized Case, Sentence case, aLtErNaTe, iNVERSE Programming cases camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE; each line converted on its own Output The same box; Copy, or Download as converted.txt

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: Every case is computed by JavaScript in this page, with your browser's Unicode rules for letters and sentences. The text you paste is never sent to us or to anyone else, and it is gone when you close the tab.

faq.q: What is the difference between Title Case and Capitalized Case?
faq.a: Title Case keeps short words such as a, the, of, in or to in lower case unless they open or close the title, while Capitalized Case capitalizes every word. The short words come from a fixed list, so through or between are capitalized. Both keep words like iPhone, and in a text typed all in capitals only known acronyms such as NASA, PDF or USA stay in capitals.

faq.q: Does Sentence case capitalize after every period?
faq.a: No. It capitalizes the first word of the text, of each line, and after ! or ?, and after a period when the next word already starts with a capital. After a period followed by a lower-case word, as in hello world. this is, the word stays lower-case, because Unicode sentence rules read that period as an abbreviation.

faq.q: Can I fix text typed with caps lock on?
faq.a: Yes. Click "Sentence case": a sentence written mostly in capitals is lowered, then its first letter is raised; known acronyms such as NASA, USA or PDF keep their capitals, and i, i'm or i'll become I, I'm, I'll. For text like hELLO wORLD, "iNVERSE" gives Hello World.

faq.q: Does snake_case split words joined together, like myHTTPServer?
faq.a: Yes, at changes of case as well as at spaces and punctuation: myHTTPServer becomes my_http_server. Apostrophes inside a word are dropped, so don't stop becomes dont_stop, accented letters are kept (café_crème), and every line is converted separately.

tips: Paste a column of names copied from a spreadsheet to turn them all into kebab-case or snake_case at once, one per line.

title: Character Counter — Letters, Digits, Spaces, Byte Size
desc: Count characters as they appear on screen, plus letters, digits, spaces, lines, UTF-16 code units and UTF-8 bytes, updated as you type.
ui: Character Counter Count characters in real time 0 Total Characters 0 Letters 0 Digits 0 Spaces 0 Other symbols 0 Without spaces 0 Lines 0 UTF-16 units 0 UTF-8 bytes Clear

about.heading: About Character Counter
about.text: Character Counter shows nine counts for the text you type or paste: total characters, letters, digits, spaces, other symbols, characters without spaces, lines, UTF-16 code units and UTF-8 bytes. Characters are counted as you see them, so an emoji with a skin tone, a flag, or an accent typed as a separate mark counts as one. Use it to check a text against a character limit, or the byte size a field will store. It only counts: it does not edit, save or send the text, and it runs in your browser.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Two lines of text. The line break is one of the 3 spaces, and 👍🏽 is one character but 4 UTF-16 units and 8 bytes. Text Café 👍🏽 #1 ok Counts shown Total Characters: 12 Letters: 6 Digits: 1 Spaces: 3 Other symbols: 2 Without spaces: 9 Lines: 2 UTF-16 units: 15 UTF-8 bytes: 20

howto: Paste the text whose length you need to check, or type it in the box.
Read the nine counts under it; they change with every keystroke.
Compare "UTF-16 units" with a web form's maxlength, or "UTF-8 bytes" with a limit expressed in bytes.
Click "Clear" to empty the box.
howtoHeading: How to count characters in a text

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Counts Total Characters, Letters, Digits, Spaces, Other symbols, Without spaces, Lines, UTF-16 units, UTF-8 bytes Spaces Every whitespace character, tabs and line breaks included Lines Zero for an empty box; a line break at the very end adds one more, empty line Digits Digits of every script, and number signs such as ½ or ²

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: The counts are recalculated by JavaScript inside this page on each keystroke; the text never leaves your device and is not saved, so a reload empties the box. The page has no error message of its own; if it ever crashed, our error log would receive the error message, the tool name and your browser's name and version, without your text.

faq.q: Does the character count include spaces?
faq.a: Yes. "Total Characters" includes spaces, tabs and line breaks, while "Without spaces" leaves all of them out. The "Spaces" count covers every kind of whitespace, so a text written on two lines always has at least one: the line break.

faq.q: How are emoji and accents counted?
faq.a: One each, as they appear: 👍🏽 and 👨‍👩‍👧 each count as one character, and so does é typed as e plus a combining accent. This relies on Intl.Segmenter, which Firefox has had since version 125; older Firefox versions count code points instead, so 👨‍👩‍👧 counts as 5 there.

faq.q: Is a form's maxlength the same as Total Characters?
faq.a: No. JavaScript and the maxlength of web forms count UTF-16 code units: a plain letter is 1, but 👍🏽 is 4. A limit set in bytes, as in some databases, file formats and APIs, matches "UTF-8 bytes", where é takes 2 and 👍🏽 takes 8.

faq.q: Are letters from other alphabets counted as letters?
faq.a: Yes. é, ß, я, 日 and every other Unicode letter count as letters, and digits of any script count as digits, as do signs like ½ or ². Emoji, punctuation and symbols such as # go to "Other symbols".

tips: To count words, sentences and reading time on the same text, paste it into Word Counter.

title: Remove Duplicate Lines — Keep the First, Same Order
desc: Delete repeated lines from a list and keep the first copy of each, in order. Options ignore case or edge spaces and drop empty lines.
ui: Duplicate Remover Remove duplicate lines from text Ignore case Ignore surrounding spaces Remove empty lines Remove Duplicates

about.heading: About Duplicate Remover
about.text: Duplicate Remover deletes the lines that appear more than once in a list or text and keeps the first copy of each, in the original order. It suits mailing lists, keyword lists and log extracts pasted one item per line. Three options change the comparison: ignore upper and lower case, ignore spaces around a line, and remove empty lines. Lines are compared after Unicode normalization, so é typed as one character or as e plus an accent match. It compares whole lines, not words, and runs in your browser.

example.heading: Example
example.text: With "Ignore case" and "Ignore surrounding spaces" ticked; the page then shows 3 lines removed. List apple Banana apple Apple banana cherry Result apple Banana cherry

howto: Paste your list into the box, one item per line.
Tick "Ignore case" when Apple and apple are the same item, "Ignore surrounding spaces" for stray spaces, and "Remove empty lines" to drop blank lines.
Click "Remove Duplicates"; the number of lines removed appears above the button.
Copy the cleaned list with "Copy", or keep it as a file with "Download" (deduplicated.txt).
howtoHeading: How to remove duplicate lines

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Input Pasted text; Windows, old Mac and Unix line breaks are all read Kept line The first occurrence, exactly as written, with its own spaces and case Empty lines Compared like other lines, so only the first one stays; Remove empty lines drops them all Output Kept lines in their original order with Unix line breaks, ready to copy or to save as deduplicated.txt

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: The comparison runs in JavaScript within this page, using a list of seen lines held in memory. Your lines never leave the browser and are forgotten when you close the tab. If copying the result fails, the page shows Copy failed and our error log receives the message "Copy to the clipboard failed." with the tool name and browser version, but no line of your list.

faq.q: Are Apple and apple counted as duplicates?
faq.a: No, unless you tick "Ignore case". With "Ignore surrounding spaces" ticked, a line with spaces before or after it also matches the same line without them. In every case the line kept is the first one, as you typed it.

faq.q: Does it keep the blank lines between paragraphs?
faq.a: No. Empty lines are compared like any other line, so only the first one survives and later paragraph breaks are removed as duplicates. Tick "Remove empty lines" to drop them all; the removed count then includes them.

faq.q: Can it remove duplicate words inside a line?
faq.a: No. It compares whole lines only. Two lines holding the same words in another order, or with different punctuation, are both kept. To see how two versions differ word by word, use Text Comparator instead.

faq.q: Does it work with lists copied from Excel or Windows?
faq.a: Yes. Windows (CRLF), old Mac (CR) and Unix (LF) line endings are all recognized, so the last line of a pasted column matches its copy elsewhere. The result is written with Unix line breaks.

tips: Sort the cleaned list afterwards with Text Sorter, whose A-Z order puts item 2 before item 10.

title: Find and Replace Text — Plain Text or Regex, Whole Words
desc: Replace every match in a text at once, as plain text or a JavaScript regular expression, with ignore-case and whole-word options.
ui: Find and Replace Replace every match, as plain text or a regular expression Find Replace with Use regular expression Ignore case Whole words only Replace All

about.heading: About Find and Replace
about.text: Find and Replace swaps every occurrence of a search term in your text for a replacement in one pass, shows the result in a separate box and says how many replacements were made. By default the search and the replacement are plain text, so characters such as . ( ) and $1 mean themselves. Tick Use regular expression for JavaScript patterns with capture groups, Ignore case to match any case, and Whole words only to skip matches inside longer words, in any alphabet except for a regex that the Unicode mode refuses, where only the common scripts count. Your original text is not changed, and your text never leaves your device.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Plain text with "Ignore case" and "Whole words only" ticked: USDT is left alone and the $ is inserted as typed. The page shows 2 replacement(s) made. Text (Find: USD, Replace with: US$) Total: 5 USD. Tax: 1 usd. USDT is not a match. Result Total: 5 US$. Tax: 1 US$. USDT is not a match.

howto: Paste your text into the first box.
Fill in "Find" and "Replace with"; leave "Replace with" empty to delete every match.
Tick "Use regular expression", "Ignore case" or "Whole words only" if needed.
Click "Replace All", check the count, then click "Copy" or "Download" to keep replaced.txt.
howtoHeading: How to find and replace text

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Search modes Plain text (default) or JavaScript regular expression Options Ignore case; Whole words only (letters, digits and marks of any script) Regex flags g always; i with Ignore case; u with Whole words only, except for a pattern the u flag refuses, which then runs without it; never m or s Output A separate Result box with the count; Copy, or Download as replaced.txt

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: Matching and replacing use your browser's own regular-expression engine; your text is never uploaded. When a regular expression is invalid, the error shown on the page is reported to our error log with the tool name and browser version, and that error can contain part of your pattern.

faq.q: Is the search case-sensitive?
faq.a: Yes, by default: USD does not match usd. Tick "Ignore case" to match both. In plain-text mode the replacement is still inserted exactly as you typed it, whatever the case of the match.

faq.q: Can I use capture groups like $1?
faq.a: Yes, with "Use regular expression" ticked: $1 inserts the first captured group and $& the whole match, as in JavaScript. Without regex mode, $1 and $& are inserted literally, so a price written as US$ stays intact.

faq.q: Do ^ and $ match the start of each line?
faq.a: No. The pattern runs without the multiline flag, so ^ matches only the very start of the text and $ only its end. To act on each line, match the line break itself, written \n in regex mode. The replacement field cannot insert a line break.

faq.q: Does Whole words only work with accented and non-Latin words?
faq.a: Yes. A match is skipped when a letter, digit, combining mark or underscore of any script touches it, so café is not found inside cafés. One exception: a regex the Unicode mode refuses, such as a\-b, falls back to the letters of the common scripts only.

faq.q: Can I undo a replacement?
faq.a: Yes, in effect: your original text stays unchanged in the first box and the result goes to a separate box. Change the options and click "Replace All" again for a new result.

tips: Build and test a complex pattern in Regex Tester first, then paste it into the Find field here.

title: Lorem Ipsum Generator — Exact Words, Sentences, Paragraphs
desc: Generate an exact number of Lorem ipsum words, sentences or paragraphs, opening with the start of the classic passage. Same request, same text.
ui: Lorem Ipsum Generator Generate placeholder text Amount Type Paragraphs Sentences Words Generate

about.heading: About Lorem Ipsum Generator
about.text: Lorem Ipsum Generator writes Latin-like placeholder text for mockups, wireframes and layout tests. Choose Paragraphs, Sentences or Words and an amount: you get exactly that many words, sentences of 8 to 16 words, or paragraphs of five sentences separated by a blank line. The text is taken from the classic Lorem ipsum passage, repeated as often as needed, so any length is possible. It is deterministic, not random. It produces plain text only, with no HTML tags and no other languages, and it is generated in your browser.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Amount 2, Type Sentences. The same request always gives this text. Settings Amount: 2 Type: Sentences Result Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipiscing elit. Tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua ut enim ad minim veniam quis nostrud.

howto: Choose Paragraphs, Sentences or Words in the "Type" dropdown.
Enter a whole number in "Amount"; the arrows stop at 100, but you can type a larger number.
Click "Generate", then "Copy" the text or "Download" it as lorem-ipsum.txt.
howtoHeading: How to generate Lorem ipsum text

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Types Paragraphs (five sentences, a blank line between them), Sentences (8 to 16 words), Words Amount Any whole number from 1; the field's arrows go up to 100 Start Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet; in Words mode, only as many of those first words as you ask for Output Placeholder text with a blank line between paragraphs, to copy or download as lorem-ipsum.txt

Where the text is generated.heading: Where the text is generated
Where the text is generated.text: The words come from a fixed list inside the code of this page and are assembled in your browser, so nothing you choose is sent anywhere. An empty, zero or negative amount sends the message "Enter a whole number of 1 or more." to our error log with the tool name and your browser name and version, and no text is generated.

faq.q: Is the Lorem ipsum text random?
faq.a: No. It is deterministic: the same type and amount always produce the same text, opening with the first words of the classic passage (just Lorem when you ask for a single word). Each sentence takes consecutive words of the classic passage, so the result is identical on every visit and every device.

faq.q: Can I generate more than 100 paragraphs?
faq.a: Yes. Type the number in "Amount" yourself: the arrows stop at 100, but the generator accepts any whole number from 1 and repeats the passage as often as needed. No upper limit is set in the code.

faq.q: Are the word counts exact?
faq.a: Yes. Words gives exactly the number asked, ending with a period; Sentences gives that many sentences of 8 to 16 words; Paragraphs gives that many blocks of five sentences. That makes it useful for testing a layout with a known amount of text.

faq.q: Does it generate HTML paragraphs?
faq.a: No. The output is plain text: paragraphs are separated by an empty line, with no p tags. Wrap them yourself, or paste them into an editor that turns blank lines into paragraphs.

tips: Generate Words with a fixed amount, then check the length in Character Counter to test a field that limits characters.

title: Sticky Notes — Colored Notes Saved in Your Browser
desc: Write quick notes in six colors and keep them on a board stored in this browser's local storage, with no account. Notes stay on this device only.
ui: Sticky Notes Create and manage sticky notes Add Note

about.heading: About Sticky Notes
about.text: Sticky Notes puts short text notes on a colored board, for a to-do list, phone numbers or reminders while you work. Each note keeps its line breaks and takes one of six colors: yellow, green, blue, pink, purple or orange. Notes are saved automatically in the local storage of this browser and come back when you reopen the page in the same browser, unless Safari has cleared them: it deletes the storage of a site you have not opened during seven days of browsing. There is no account and no sync: notes cannot be edited, moved, exported or shared, and they exist on this device only.

example.heading: Example
example.text: What this page stores after you add one yellow note: the key sticky-notes in local storage. The id is the time the note was added. Note (color: yellow) Call the plumber before 5 pm Stored in local storage [{"id":1759700000000,"text":"Call the plumber\nbefore 5 pm","color":"bg-yellow-300"}]

howto: Type your note in the box; line breaks are kept.
Pick a color among the six round buttons; yellow is selected at first.
Click "Add Note"; the note appears on the board and is saved at once.
Click the X of a note to delete it; there is no confirmation and no undo.
howtoHeading: How to add a sticky note

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Storage This browser's local storage, under the key sticky-notes Colors Yellow, green, blue, pink, purple, orange Editing None: delete a note and add it again to change it Devices One browser on one device; a private window loses its notes when it closes

Where your notes are kept.heading: Where your notes are kept
Where your notes are kept.text: Your notes are written to local storage on this device by the page itself. They are never uploaded and no copy exists on our side, so we cannot restore them. Clearing the data of this site, closing a private window, or not opening this page in Safari for seven days of browsing deletes them for good.

faq.q: Will my notes still be here tomorrow?
faq.a: Yes, in the same browser on the same device, as long as you do not clear the data of this site. In a private or incognito window the browser erases local storage when the window closes, so those notes disappear.

faq.q: Can I open my notes on my phone or another computer?
faq.a: No. Notes live in the local storage of the browser that created them; there is no account and no cloud copy. To move a note, copy its text by hand and add it again on the other device.

faq.q: Can I edit a note after adding it?
faq.a: No. A note can only be deleted with its X button. To change one, copy its text into the box, edit it, click "Add Note", then delete the old note.

tips: Give each project or person its own color, since notes cannot be renamed, grouped or reordered.

title: Text Comparator — Side-by-Side Diff With Changed Words
desc: Paste two texts and see them side by side: matching lines aligned, changed words in red and green, added lines alone. Case and spacing can be ignored.
ui: Text Comparator Compare two texts side by side Text 1 Text 2 Ignore case Ignore spaces Compare

about.heading: About Text Comparator
about.text: Text Comparator puts two versions of a text side by side and marks what changed. Lines are matched with the Myers diff algorithm of the jsdiff library; inside a changed line, the words that differ are highlighted, red in the first text and green in the second. An inserted or deleted line is shown on its own row and the rest stays aligned. It suits drafts, contract clauses and edited lists. It compares pasted text, not files, gives no line numbers, and runs in your browser.

example.heading: Example
example.text: The ≠ sign stands for a red-tinted row and brackets for the words highlighted in red (left) and green (right); the page shows 2 difference(s) found. Text 1 / Text 2 Text 1: Dear Anna, The meeting is on Monday. Please bring the report. Thanks, Text 2: Dear Anna, The meeting is on Tuesday. Please bring the report. See you there. Thanks, Rows shown Dear Anna, | Dear Anna, ≠ The meeting is on [Monday]. | The meeting is on [Tuesday]. Please bring the report. | Please bring the report. ≠ empty | See you there. Thanks, | Thanks,

howto: Put the older wording in "Text 1" and the newer one in "Text 2".
Tick "Ignore case" when one version was retyped with other capitals, or "Ignore spaces" when only the spacing changed.
Click "Compare"; the button works once both boxes hold text.
Read the number of differences, then the rows: dark grey rows match, red-tinted rows differ, with changed words marked.
howtoHeading: How to compare two texts

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Input Two pasted texts; Windows, Mac and Unix line breaks compare as equal Ignore spaces Ignores spaces at both ends of a line and the number of spaces between words; a b and ab still differ Ignore case Lines compared in lower case; each side is still shown as written Result Rows on screen only, with no copy, download or line numbers

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: Both texts are compared in this tab by the jsdiff library, which the page fetches from this site the first time you click Compare. The texts themselves are never transmitted, and nothing is kept once you leave the page. This page offers no copy or download of the comparison, so it exists only on your screen.

faq.q: Does one inserted line make every following line different?
faq.a: No. Only the inserted line is marked, opposite an empty cell, and the lines after it stay paired with their counterparts. Each changed or unmatched row adds one to the difference count shown above the rows.

faq.q: Can it ignore extra spaces?
faq.a: Yes, partly. "Ignore spaces" ignores spaces at the start and end of each line and treats several spaces as one, but a space present on one side only still counts: a b and ab differ. Inside changed lines, the word highlighting then skips spacing changes.

faq.q: Can I compare two Word or PDF files?
faq.a: No. Paste the text of each version instead. To check that two files of any type are byte-for-byte identical, use File Comparator; to compare code with line numbers, use Diff Viewer.

tips: Text pasted from a PDF often breaks lines differently in each version; join each version into one line with Whitespace Remover first, then compare the words.

title: Text Encryptor — Password-Based AES-256-GCM Encryption
desc: Encrypt a message with a password using AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2, then share the Base64 result. Decrypt it here with the same password.
ui: Text Encryptor Encrypt and decrypt text with a key Secret Key Encrypt Decrypt

about.heading: About Text Encryptor
about.text: Text Encryptor turns a message into Base64 ciphertext that only someone with the password can read, and turns it back. It uses AES-256-GCM through your browser's Web Crypto API, with a key derived from the password by PBKDF2-SHA-256 over 600,000 iterations and a new random salt and IV for each message, so the same text never encrypts the same way twice. Use it for notes or messages sent through a channel you do not fully trust, with the password shared another way. It encrypts text only; File Encryptor handles files.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Encrypted with the password blue-harbor-42. Your own result will differ, but this one decrypts back to the message with that password. Text (Secret Key: blue-harbor-42) Meet at 6 Result after "Encrypt" T0NUMa1WBvLr2YnFybvyCCO1NYbVK+A6yHrUtZy1FHedD2vbLXuiD+a6YGuKU6QOoP+BnTHvrSVS

howto: Paste the message to encrypt, or the Base64 text to decrypt, into the box.
Type a long passphrase in "Secret Key"; the field hides what you type.
Click "Encrypt" or "Decrypt"; both stay inactive until the box and the key are filled.
Click "Copy", or "Download" to save the result as encrypted.txt, a name kept even after decrypting.
howtoHeading: How to encrypt and decrypt text with a password

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Algorithm PBKDF2-SHA-256 turns the password into a key over 600,000 iterations, then AES-256-GCM encrypts the message Per message A random 16-byte salt and a random 12-byte IV Encrypted text Base64 of the marker OCT1, the salt, the IV, the ciphertext and its tag, so it always starts with T0NU Old format Texts encrypted with the XOR method used before 29 September 2026 still decrypt, with a warning

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: Your browser's Web Crypto API does both the encrypting and the decrypting on this page. The message, the password and the result are never sent to us, so no copy exists that could be recovered. Error messages shown here, such as a wrong-password warning, are reported to our error log with the tool name and your browser name and version, without your text or password.

faq.q: Is the encryption safe with a short password?
faq.a: No. AES-256-GCM is not the weak point: a short or common password can still be guessed by trying many candidates, and the 600,000 PBKDF2 iterations only slow each guess down. Use a long passphrase that you do not use anywhere else.

faq.q: Will a wrong password give me garbled text?
faq.a: No, for texts encrypted since 29 September 2026: AES-GCM checks integrity, so a wrong password or a changed text is refused with an error. Base64 in the old XOR format, or any Base64 not made by this tool, cannot be checked, so a wrong password there may show unreadable text with the old-format warning.

faq.q: Can you recover my text if I forget the password?
faq.a: No. We never receive the password or the text. The encrypted text holds everything needed to decrypt it except the password, so without it nobody can read the message.

faq.q: Is it normal that the same text encrypts differently each time?
faq.a: Yes. A new random salt and IV are drawn for every message, so two results never match, which also hides that two messages are identical. Any of those results decrypts with the same password.

tips: Send the password through a different channel than the encrypted text, for example by phone.

title: Text Repeater — Repeat a Word or Line up to 100 Times
desc: Repeat any text from 1 to 100 times, joined by a new line, a space, a comma or nothing, then copy it or save it as a .txt file.
ui: Text Repeater Repeat text multiple times Repeat count Separator New Line Space Comma None Repeat

about.heading: About Text Repeater
about.text: Text Repeater copies a word, a line or a whole paragraph a chosen number of times, from 1 to 100, and joins the copies with a new line, a space, a comma followed by a space, or nothing at all. It is handy for test data, for filling a field to check its limit, or for building a repeated pattern. The text is repeated exactly as typed, line breaks included. There is no custom separator, and a count outside 1 to 100 is refused with a message. All copies are joined on your device, not on a server.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Repeat count 3 with the Comma separator: each comma is followed by a space. Text Hip hip hooray! Result Hip hip hooray!, Hip hip hooray!, Hip hip hooray!

howto: Type or paste the text to repeat.
Set "Repeat count" to a whole number from 1 to 100; it starts at 3.
Choose "New Line", "Space", "Comma" or "None" in the "Separator" dropdown.
Click "Repeat", then "Copy" the result or "Download" it as repeated.txt.
howtoHeading: How to repeat text

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Repetitions 1 to 100, whole numbers only Separators New Line, Space, Comma (a comma and a space), None Output One string of joined copies, available through Copy or as the file repeated.txt

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: The copies are joined by one line of JavaScript in this page, so your text stays in your browser and is never transmitted. A count outside the allowed range shows a red message on the page, which is not sent anywhere.

faq.q: How many times can I repeat a text?
faq.a: 100 times at most, and at least once. A count of 0, a decimal or a number above 100 is refused with the message Enter a whole number of repetitions from 1 to 100, and no result is made.

faq.q: Can I use my own separator, such as a semicolon?
faq.a: No. Only the four presets exist. Choose New Line, copy the result, then replace the line breaks with your separator in your editor. With None the copies touch each other, leaving no boundary to replace.

faq.q: Is there a space after the comma?
faq.a: Yes. Comma joins the copies with a comma and a space, as in a, a, a. To get copies without that space, end your own text with a comma, pick None, then delete the comma left at the very end.

tips: To fill a field up to a known length, repeat a short word and check the total in Character Counter.

title: Text Reverser — Reverse Letters, Word Order or Line Order
desc: Write a text backwards letter by letter, reverse the word order of each line, or flip the order of lines. Emoji and accents stay whole.
ui: Text Reverser Reverse any text, words or lines Reverse Text Reverse Words Reverse Lines

about.heading: About Text Reverser
about.text: Text Reverser has three buttons. Reverse Text writes the whole text backwards, character by character, keeping emoji, flags and accented letters whole. Reverse Words reverses the order of the words on each line, with punctuation staying attached to its word and line breaks staying in place. Reverse Lines reverses the order of the lines and leaves each line unchanged. Use it for word games, backwards messages or flipping a list from oldest to newest. It does not turn letters upside down, and it runs in your browser.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Reverse Words: each line is reversed on its own, punctuation stays with its word, and the double space keeps its place. Text Hello, big world! One two three After "Reverse Words" world! big Hello, three two One

howto: Type or paste your text.
Click "Reverse Text", "Reverse Words" or "Reverse Lines".
Copy the reversed text with "Copy", or save it with "Download" as reversed.txt.
howtoHeading: How to reverse text

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Reverse Text Characters as displayed: 👍🏽, 👨‍👩‍👧, 🇫🇷 and é typed as e plus an accent stay whole Reverse Words Word order on each line; spacing pattern and punctuation kept Reverse Lines Line order only; empty lines move like the others Output The flipped text in a result box below the buttons, plus a reversed.txt download

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: All three reversals are array operations done by your browser on the text of this page; none of it is uploaded, and closing the tab discards it. A failed copy to the clipboard is reported to our error log as "Copy to the clipboard failed." with the tool name and your browser name and version, and none of your text.

faq.q: Does Reverse Words move punctuation?
faq.a: No. Words are the runs of characters between spaces, so a comma or an exclamation mark stays glued to the word it follows: Hello, big world! becomes world! big Hello,. Each line is processed on its own.

faq.q: Can I check a palindrome with it?
faq.a: Yes, for single words typed in one case, such as level. For phrases every character counts, so capitals, spaces and punctuation must mirror too: A man, a plan becomes nalp a ,nam A. Remove spaces and use lower case first.

faq.q: Do emoji and accented letters survive Reverse Text?
faq.a: Yes, in current browsers: emoji with skin tones, family emoji, flags and accents typed as separate marks are kept whole. Firefox before version 125 has no Intl.Segmenter, so such emoji and accents can come apart there.

tips: Reverse Lines turns a log or a list written oldest-first into newest-first without sorting anything.

title: Text Sorter — Sort Lines A-Z, by Length, Number or Random
desc: Sort lines in dictionary order, by length or by leading number, or shuffle them. Item 2 comes before item 10, and capitals sort with lower case.
ui: Text Sorter Sort lines alphabetically or by length Sort A-Z Sort Z-A Sort by Length Shuffle Sort by Number (0-9) Sort by Number (9-0)

about.heading: About Text Sorter
about.text: Text Sorter reorders the lines of a list. Sort A-Z and Sort Z-A follow dictionary order in the language of your browser: capitals and lower case sort together, accented letters sit next to their base letter in most languages, and numbers inside a line are compared by value. Sort by Length goes from shortest to longest. The two Sort by Number buttons read the number at the start of each line, decimals and minus signs included. Shuffle puts the lines in random order. It sorts whole lines, not words, in your browser.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Sort A-Z: case is ignored, é sorts with e, and item 2 comes before item 10. Lines item 10 Banana zebra éclair apple item 2 After "Sort A-Z" apple Banana éclair item 2 item 10 zebra

howto: Paste the lines to reorder, for example names, file names or numbers.
Click "Sort A-Z", "Sort Z-A", "Sort by Length", "Shuffle", "Sort by Number (0-9)" or "Sort by Number (9-0)".
Take the sorted list with "Copy", or "Download" it as sorted.txt.
howtoHeading: How to sort lines of text

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Alphabetical Case-insensitive, accents second, numbers by value, in your browser's language By number Number at the start of each line, with sign, decimals and exponent; other lines follow in A-Z order By length Characters as displayed, shortest first; equal lengths in A-Z order Output Sorted lines as one text block with Unix line breaks, copied or downloaded as sorted.txt

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: Sorting uses the collator built into your browser and, for Shuffle, its cryptographic random generator. The lines never leave the page and are not stored. Should a copy to the clipboard fail, our error log receives that error message with the tool name and browser version, never the lines themselves.

faq.q: Does item 10 sort after item 2?
faq.a: Yes. Sort A-Z compares runs of digits by value, as file managers do, so file2 comes before file10. For a list of plain numbers with decimals or minus signs, use "Sort by Number (0-9)": -10, -2, 1.25, 1.3, 1.5.

faq.q: Is sorting case-sensitive?
faq.a: No. apple, Banana and cherry sort together, as in a dictionary. When two lines differ only by case or accents, a second comparison decides between them, so the result is the same every time.

faq.q: Do accented letters sort next to their base letter?
faq.a: Yes, in English, French, German and most other languages: éclair comes before zebra. The order follows the language of your browser, so in Swedish or Danish å, ä, ö, æ and ø come after z, as in those alphabets.

faq.q: Is Shuffle really random?
faq.a: Yes. It is a Fisher-Yates shuffle fed by crypto.getRandomValues, the cryptographic generator of the browser. Because each draw is a 32-bit number, a modulo bias remains, at most n in 4,294,967,296 for a list of n lines.

tips: Remove repeated lines first with Duplicate Remover, then sort the shorter list here.

title: Text to List — Bullet, Numbered or Comma-Separated List
desc: Turn lines of text into a bullet list with •, a numbered list, or one comma-separated line. Blank lines are skipped. Copy it or save a .txt file.
ui: Text to List Convert text to different list formats Bullet List Numbered List Comma List

about.heading: About Text to List
about.text: Text to List formats a column of items, one per line, in one of three ways: a bullet list with the • character, a numbered list (1., 2., 3.), or a single line with the items separated by a comma and a space. Blank lines are skipped. Bullet and numbered lists also trim the spaces around each item, while the comma list keeps them. Use it to tidy a list copied from a spreadsheet or an email. It outputs plain text, not a Word or HTML list, and runs in your browser.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Numbered List: the blank line is skipped and the spaces around Sugar are trimmed. Items Flour Sugar Eggs After "Numbered List" 1. Flour 2. Sugar 3. Eggs

howto: Paste your items, one per line.
Click "Bullet List", "Numbered List" or "Comma List".
Click "Copy" to paste the list elsewhere, or "Download" for list.txt.
howtoHeading: How to turn text into a list

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Formats • item, 1. item, or item, item, item on one line Blank lines Skipped in all three formats Spaces Trimmed in Bullet List and Numbered List, kept in Comma List Output A single block of formatted text; the download is named list.txt

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: Splitting, numbering and joining are done by a few lines of JavaScript in your browser, so your list is not uploaded. If the clipboard refuses a copy, our error log receives "Copy to the clipboard failed." with the tool name and your browser name and version, never the list. Neither the items nor the formatted result are stored after you close the page.

faq.q: Can I download the list?
faq.a: Yes. "Download" saves it as list.txt, plain text in UTF-8, and on an iPhone or iPad "Save / Share" appears too. There is no Word or PDF output: paste the text into your editor and apply its own list style.

faq.q: Does it remove existing bullets or numbers?
faq.a: No. A line that already starts with a dash or with 1. keeps it, so you would get • - item. Find and Replace can strip a dash marker that every line shares (a dash and a space replaced with nothing); numbers must be removed in your editor.

faq.q: Can I choose another separator or bullet?
faq.a: No. The bullet is always •, numbers are followed by a period and a space, and the comma list uses a comma and a space. For another separator, make a Comma List and replace the commas in Find and Replace.

tips: Comma List turns a column of email addresses into one line you can paste into the To field of a mail app that accepts comma-separated addresses.

title: Text Truncator — Shorten Text to N Characters or Words
desc: Cut a text to a set number of characters or words and add ... where it was cut. Emoji and accents are never split, and spacing is kept.
ui: Text Truncator Truncate text to specific length Limit Type Characters Words Truncate

about.heading: About Text Truncator
about.text: Text Truncator shortens a text to a limit you set, counted in characters or in words, for previews, excerpts, captions or form fields. When it cuts, it adds three dots after the kept part, and the dots are not counted in the limit. Characters are counted as they appear, so an emoji or an accented letter is never cut in half. In word mode the original spacing and line breaks are kept up to the last word. A text already within the limit comes back unchanged. The cut is made on your device.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Limit 4, Type Words: the cut falls right after the fourth word. Text The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. Result The quick brown fox...

howto: Paste your text.
Enter the "Limit", which starts at 100, and choose Characters or Words in the "Type" dropdown.
Click "Truncate".
Click "Copy" for the shortened text, or "Download" for truncated.txt.
howtoHeading: How to truncate text

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Units Characters as displayed, or Words (runs of non-space characters) Limit Any whole number, 0 included; 0 gives the three dots alone Ellipsis Three ASCII periods, added only when the text is cut, not counted in the limit Output The shortened text in a result box; Download saves it as truncated.txt

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: The text is measured and cut by JavaScript in this tab, so it never travels over the network. An invalid limit shows an error message, and that message, with the tool name and browser version but without your text, is recorded in our error log. The shortened text is kept only in the result box until you leave.

faq.q: Is the ellipsis counted in the limit?
faq.a: No. The limit applies to your text only and the three dots are added after the kept part, so the result can be three characters longer than the limit. In character mode, spaces just before the cut are removed first.

faq.q: Can it cut an emoji or accented letter in half?
faq.a: No, in current browsers: it counts what you see, so 👍🏽, flags and accents typed as separate marks stay whole. Firefox before version 125 lacks the segmenter used here and counts code points instead, which can split such characters.

faq.q: Does word mode stop in the middle of a word?
faq.a: No. A word is any run of characters between spaces or line breaks, and the cut falls right after the last word kept, with your original spaces and line breaks before it. Punctuation attached to that word stays.

faq.q: Can I get the single … character instead of three dots?
faq.a: No. The tool always adds three ASCII periods, never the single ellipsis character. If your style guide needs it, replace the three dots afterwards with Find and Replace in its default plain-text mode.

title: URL Encoder & Decoder — Make Text Safe for Web Links
desc: Turn spaces, accents and symbols into %XX codes for a link, or read a garbled %20 address as plain words again. Nothing leaves your browser.
ui: URL Encoder Encode and decode URLs Decode “+” as a space (form data and query strings) Encode as A value (query parameter, path segment) A whole URL (keeps : / ? # & = + ; , @ $) Strict RFC 3986 (also ! ' ( ) *) Encode Decode

about.heading: About URL Encoder
about.text: URL Encoder makes ordinary text safe to put in a web address, and turns encoded addresses back into readable words. Spaces become %20, an accented letter becomes its UTF-8 bytes (é is %C3%A9), and in the default mode symbols such as & or ? are escaped so they do not cut a link short. Paste a long link full of %20 and %C3 codes and Decode shows it in plain text. You can encode a single word or phrase, a complete address, or use a strict variant that also escapes ! ' ( ) *. The conversion uses functions built into your browser, so nothing is uploaded.

example.heading: Example
example.text: A song title encoded with the default mode and with the strict mode, then a form-style query decoded with the + box ticked: Text Rock 'n' Roll (live)! To decode: Rock+%27n%27+Roll Result Default mode: Rock%20'n'%20Roll%20(live)! Strict RFC 3986: Rock%20%27n%27%20Roll%20%28live%29%21 Decoded: Rock 'n' Roll

howto: Type or paste your text, or an address full of %XX codes.
To encode, keep "A value (query parameter, path segment)" for a word or phrase, or switch to "A whole URL (keeps : / ? # & = + ; , @ $)" for a full address.
Click "Encode" or "Decode"; if a + in your text is a real plus sign, untick the + box first.
Click "Copy" to paste the result somewhere else, or "Download" for a text file named encoded.txt.
howtoHeading: How to encode or decode text for a link

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: What gets encoded Spaces, accents, emoji and symbols; letters, digits and - _ . ~ always stay as they are Modes A value, A whole URL, and Strict RFC 3986, which also escapes ! ' ( ) * Decoding %XX codes are read as UTF-8; + becomes a space unless you untick the box Errors An incomplete code, such as %E9 alone, shows Invalid URL encoding

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: This page converts your text with functions built into the browser and does not send it anywhere, so private links and search terms stay on your device. If the clipboard refuses a copy or a decode fails, we receive a short error message, the tool's name and your browser's name and version, never your text, to help fix bugs.

faq.q: How do I decode a URL full of %20 and %C3 codes?
faq.a: Paste it and click "Decode". Each %XX group is read as a UTF-8 byte, so %C3%A9 becomes é and %20 becomes a space. If the address contains a real plus sign, untick the + box first, or it turns into a space.

faq.q: Why does é become %C3%A9 and not %E9?
faq.a: Web addresses use UTF-8, where é takes two bytes, C3 and A9. %E9 is the older Latin-1 code; on its own it is not valid UTF-8, so Decode answers Invalid URL encoding instead of guessing.

faq.q: Which characters are left as they are?
faq.a: In the default mode, letters, digits and - _ . ! ~ * ' ( ) stay unchanged and everything else is escaped. Strict RFC 3986 escapes ! ' ( ) * as well, and A whole URL also keeps the separators of an address, such as : / ? # & =.

faq.q: Can I encode a whole web address?
faq.a: Yes, with "A whole URL (keeps : / ? # & = + ; , @ $)". It keeps the separators and any %XX codes already there, and encodes spaces and accents, so the link still opens. In the default mode the slashes and the colon would be escaped too.

tips: A link copied from an e-mail that looks broken can be decoded first, to read the address it really points to.
Encode search words separately, then put them after ?q= in the address.

title: Whitespace Remover — Extra Spaces, Tabs and Blank Lines
desc: Collapse repeated spaces and tabs, trim each line and shorten runs of blank lines without merging your lines, or join everything into one line.
ui: Whitespace Remover Remove extra spaces and blank lines, or join lines into one Remove All Extra Remove Extra Spaces Remove Leading Remove Trailing Join Into One Line

about.heading: About Whitespace Remover
about.text: Whitespace Remover cleans spacing in five ways. Remove All Extra collapses repeated spaces and tabs, trims every line, and turns each run of blank lines into one, dropping those at the very start and end. Remove Extra Spaces does the same inside lines but keeps every blank line. Remove Leading and Remove Trailing trim one side of each line only. Join Into One Line replaces every run of whitespace, line breaks included, with a single space; it is the only button that merges lines. All five run on your device, inside this page.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Remove All Extra: spaces and the tab are collapsed, each line is trimmed, and three blank lines become one. Text Dear team, The report is ready. Thanks, After "Remove All Extra" Dear team, The report is ready. Thanks,

howto: Paste your text.
Click "Remove All Extra", "Remove Extra Spaces", "Remove Leading" or "Remove Trailing" to clean spacing while keeping every line of text.
Click "Join Into One Line" only to turn the whole text into a single line.
Click "Copy", or save the cleaned text with "Download" (cleaned.txt).
howtoHeading: How to remove extra spaces from text

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Spaces handled Spaces, tabs, non-breaking spaces and the other Unicode spaces JavaScript treats as whitespace Not removed Zero-width spaces (U+200B), which JavaScript does not treat as whitespace Line breaks Windows, Mac and Unix read; the result uses Unix line breaks Output Cleaned text shown under the buttons, which Download saves as cleaned.txt

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: The five clean-ups are regular-expression replacements run by your browser on this page, so the text is not uploaded or stored anywhere. If the clipboard refuses a copy, the page shows Copy failed and sends the message "Copy to the clipboard failed." with the tool name and browser version, without any of your text, to our error log.

faq.q: Will it merge my lines?
faq.a: No, unless you click "Join Into One Line". The four other buttons keep every line of text where it is; "Remove All Extra" only shortens runs of blank lines to one and drops blank lines at the start and end.

faq.q: Does it clean non-breaking spaces from web or PDF text?
faq.a: Yes. Non-breaking spaces and the other Unicode spaces that JavaScript treats as whitespace are collapsed like ordinary spaces. Zero-width spaces are not whitespace for JavaScript, so they stay in the text.

faq.q: Can I remove every space, even between words?
faq.a: No. Every button keeps at least one space between words, and "Remove Leading" and "Remove Trailing" leave the spacing inside lines untouched. To delete all spaces, use Find and Replace with a single space in Find and nothing in Replace with.

faq.q: Can it fix a PDF paragraph broken into short lines?
faq.a: Yes. "Join Into One Line" puts it back on one line with single spaces. A word split by a hyphen at the end of a line keeps the hyphen and gains a space, as in hyph- enated, so check those afterwards.

tips: Run "Remove Trailing" on code before sharing it: it strips spaces at line ends and touches nothing inside the lines.

title: Word Counter — Words, Characters, Reading Time, Keywords
desc: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs live, see reading and speaking time, and list your most used words and phrases.
ui: Word Counter Count words, characters and sentences 0 Words 0 Characters 0 No Spaces 0 Sentences 0 Paragraphs 0 Min Read About 0 min to say aloud (130 words a minute); reading time at 200 words a minute. Clear

about.heading: About Word Counter
about.text: Word Counter counts the words, characters with and without spaces, sentences and paragraphs of a text as you type, and estimates reading time at 200 words a minute and speaking time at 130. Below the counts, a keyword density table lists the most frequent words, or repeated two- and three-word phrases, with their share of all words. It relies on your browser's Unicode segmentation, so Chinese, Japanese and Thai are split into words and Mr. or 3.50 do not end a sentence. It only counts, and it runs in your browser.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Mr. and 3.50 do not end a sentence, so there are 3 sentences; $ alone is not a word. Text Mr. Smith paid $3.50 for coffee. He liked it! The next day he came back. Counts shown Words: 15 Characters: 73 No Spaces: 58 Sentences: 3 Paragraphs: 2 Min Read: 1 About 1 min to say aloud

howto: Paste your essay, article or post into the box, or start typing.
Read "Words", "Characters", "No Spaces", "Sentences", "Paragraphs" and "Min Read"; they update with each change.
Under the counts, switch the keyword table from "1 word" to two- or three-word phrases, or untick "Leave out common English words" to include the, and, of.
Click "Clear" to empty the box and start again.
howtoHeading: How to count words in a text

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Counts Words, Characters, No Spaces, Sentences, Paragraphs, Min Read, speaking time Reading speed Min Read = words ÷ 200, rounded up; speaking time = words ÷ 130, rounded up Paragraphs Every non-empty line counts, so a single line break starts a new paragraph Keyword density Up to 15 rows; phrases shown only when used more than once; 56 common English words can be left out

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: Words, sentences and characters are found by Intl.Segmenter, the text segmentation built into your browser, and every count is recomputed inside the page on each keystroke. Your text is not sent or saved: reloading the page clears it. The page has no copy or download button, so the counts stay on your screen.

faq.q: Does Characters include spaces and line breaks?
faq.a: Yes. "Characters" counts everything you typed, spaces and line breaks included, with each emoji counted once. "No Spaces" leaves out every kind of whitespace. For letters, digits or byte size, use Character Counter.

faq.q: How is reading time calculated?
faq.a: 200 words a minute, rounded up: "Min Read" is the word count divided by 200, so any text up to 200 words shows 1. The speaking time under the counts uses 130 words a minute, rounded up the same way.

faq.q: Is a number or a hyphenated word counted as one word?
faq.a: Yes for numbers: 3.50 is one word. Hyphenated words follow the Unicode word rules of your browser, which split well-known into two words. A symbol such as $ or & alone is not a word.

faq.q: Can I see keyword density?
faq.a: Yes. The table below the counts lists up to 15 words or phrases with the number of uses and their share of all words. Two- and three-word phrases appear only when used more than once, and the, and, of and similar words can be left out.

faq.q: Does it count the same way in every browser?
faq.a: No. Firefox before version 125 has no Intl.Segmenter, so there a run of Chinese, Japanese or Thai text counts as one word and 3.50 ends a sentence. Current Chrome, Edge, Safari and Firefox give the counts described here.

about.heading: About Media Player
about.text: Media Player opens one audio or video file from your device in the player built into your browser. Below it you can set the speed from 0.5× to 2× and turn on "Loop". For a video you can also open a picture-in-picture window where the browser offers it, save the current frame as a PNG, and add subtitles from an .srt or .vtt file; a subtitle file that is not UTF-8 is read in the usual Windows code page of your browser's language. It plays what your browser can decode; for a file it cannot decode, it says so and links to Video Converter or Audio Converter. It does not make playlists.

howto: Pick or drop an audio or video file.
Use the player's controls, and choose a "Speed" or tick "Loop".
For a video, click "Subtitles (.srt, .vtt)" to add a subtitle file, or "Picture in picture" to keep it on top.
Click "Save this frame", then "Download" to save the picture as a PNG.
howtoHeading: How to play an audio or video file

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Input formats Audio: MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, FLAC, OGG, OGA, Opus, WMA, AIFF, AIF, AMR, MKA, WEBA, CAF. Video: MP4, M4V, MOV, QT, WebM, MKV, AVI, WMV, FLV, OGV, 3GP, 3G2, MPG, MPEG, TS, MTS, M2TS. Playback depends on your browser. Subtitles SRT or WebVTT, for videos Saved frame PNG at the video's size; on iPhone and iPad, scaled down to fit 16.7 megapixels

Where your file is processed.heading: Where your file is processed
Where your file is processed.text: The file is opened from your device through a local blob: address and played by your browser; it is not uploaded or streamed from a server. Subtitles are converted and frames are drawn in the same tab, and the speed, loop and picture-in-picture buttons only act on the player.

faq.q: Can it play AVI, WMV or MKV files?
faq.a: Yes, if your browser can decode them. When it cannot, the page says "This browser cannot play" this file and links to Video Converter or Audio Converter, so you can make an MP4 or MP3 first.

faq.q: Can I add subtitles to a video?
faq.a: Yes: click "Subtitles (.srt, .vtt)" and pick the file. SRT timings are rewritten as WebVTT, one-digit hours included. A file that is not UTF-8 is read in the Windows code page of your browser's language, such as Windows-1252 for Western languages.

faq.q: Can I save a still image from a video?
faq.a: Yes. Pause where you want, click "Save this frame" and download the PNG. It has the video's own size, except on iPhone and iPad, where a picture over 16.7 megapixels is scaled down to fit the browser's canvas limit.

faq.q: Can I play several files in a row?
faq.a: No. The player holds one file at a time; choosing another file replaces it and clears the subtitles and the saved frame of the previous one. To hear several tracks back to back, join them first with Audio Merger.

tips: Tick "Loop" and choose 0.75× to practise a passage of music or a dance step.
Load the .srt you made in Subtitle Generator here to check its timings against the video.

about.heading: About Screen Recorder
about.text: Screen Recorder captures a screen, a window or a browser tab through the screen sharing of the browser. On Chrome and Edge, a shared tab or whole screen can bring its sound; tick "Add my microphone (mixed with the screen's sound)" to add your voice in the same track, and the page warns when a recording has no sound at all. "Pause" and "Resume" continue the same file. Where MediaRecorder can write MP4 (H.264 and AAC), as in Safari and in Chrome or Edge 126 and later, you get an MP4; Firefox records WebM, and "Make an MP4" converts it on our media service. iPhone and iPad do not allow screen recording from a web page.

howto: Tick "Add my microphone (mixed with the screen's sound)" if you want your voice, then click "Start Recording".
Choose the screen, window or tab in the browser's dialog; on Chrome or Edge, tick the box that shares the tab or system audio.
Use "Pause" and "Resume", then click "Stop Recording" or stop sharing from the browser's bar.
Click "Download" to save the MP4, or the WebM with a "Make an MP4" button below it.
howtoHeading: How to record your screen

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Sources A screen, window or tab; its sound on Chrome and Edge (tab or whole screen only); optional microphone in any browser that records Output format MP4 (H.264 + AAC) where the browser can record it; otherwise WebM, which can be converted to MP4 Length No maximum in the page; the recording is held in memory while the page is open iPhone and iPad Not available: Apple does not let web pages record the screen Usage limits "Make an MP4" only: conversions per connection are counted per hour and per day, and the media service refuses a video over its maximum size or length.

Where your recording is processed.heading: Where your recording is processed
Where your recording is processed.text: Recording happens in your browser, and the video is not sent anywhere unless you click "Make an MP4". That button uploads the WebM in pieces to our media service, which converts it to MP4; the WebM is wiped there when the conversion ends and the MP4 once the page has downloaded it, or after a set time. A failed start or conversion sends its cleaned message, with your browser's name and version, to our error log.

faq.q: Does it record sound?
faq.a: Yes, on Chrome and Edge: the sound of a shared tab or whole screen, if you tick the audio box in the sharing dialog; a window, Firefox and Safari share no sound. "Add my microphone (mixed with the screen's sound)" adds your voice in one track. With no sound at all, the page tells you.

faq.q: Will my recording play on an iPhone?
faq.a: Yes, when it is an MP4. Safari and Chrome or Edge 126 and later record MP4 directly. Firefox records WebM, which the iPhone Photos app cannot open, so click "Make an MP4" to convert it on our media service.

faq.q: Can I record my screen on an iPhone or iPad?
faq.a: No. Apple does not let browsers capture the screen there, so the page shows a notice and the start button stays off. Use Screen Recording in Control Center instead.

faq.q: Is my recording uploaded?
faq.a: No, unless you click "Make an MP4". That conversion runs on our media service, which counts conversions per connection per hour and per day, refuses videos over its maximum size or length, and deletes the file once the MP4 is downloaded.

tips: Cut the first and last seconds with Video Trimmer, where you usually reach for the stop button.

title: Subtitle Generator — Type Lines, Get SRT and VTT Files
desc: Type each subtitle with its start and end time and download valid SRT and WebVTT files, sorted by time, with every time checked before export.
ui: Subtitle Generator Create SRT and WebVTT subtitle files Subtitle 1 Remove Start (HH:MM:SS.mmm) End (HH:MM:SS.mmm) Add Subtitle Generate SRT

about.heading: About Subtitle Generator
about.text: Subtitle Generator builds subtitle files by hand. For each line you type a start time, an end time and the text; "Generate SRT" checks every time, sorts the lines by start time, skips rows without text, and writes both an .srt (SubRip) and a .vtt (WebVTT) file. Times can be written as HH:MM:SS, MM:SS or plain seconds, with milliseconds after a dot or a comma. It does not listen to a video or audio file: for timed subtitles made from speech, use Audio to Text, which exports SRT and VTT itself.

example.heading: Example
example.text: Two rows typed out of order, with short time formats (run with the page's own code, app/lib/subtitleTime.js). Rows typed (start, end, text) 0:04,5 0:07 And we are back. 1.2 3 Hello and welcome. subtitles.srt 1 00:00:01,200 --> 00:00:03,000 Hello and welcome. 2 00:00:04,500 --> 00:00:07,000 And we are back.

howto: Fill in "Start (HH:MM:SS.mmm)", "End (HH:MM:SS.mmm)" and the text of the first row.
Click "Add Subtitle" for each further line, and "Remove" to delete one.
Click "Generate SRT"; a time that cannot be read, or a line that ends before it starts, is pointed out by its number.
Check the SRT shown, then click "Download" next to subtitles.srt or subtitles.vtt, or "Download all" for both in a ZIP.
howtoHeading: How to make an SRT subtitle file

Formats and limits.heading: Formats and limits
Formats and limits.text: Input Typed rows: a start, an end and one line of text each Output formats SRT (subtitles.srt) and WebVTT (subtitles.vtt) Time format HH:MM:SS, MM:SS or SS, with up to three decimals after a dot or comma; seconds up to 59, and minutes up to 59 when hours are given

Where your text is processed.heading: Where your text is processed
Where your text is processed.text: The subtitles are built on this page from what you type, and no text is sent to a server. If the page shows an error, such as a time it cannot read, that message goes to our error log with your browser's name and version, after quoted text has been removed from it.

faq.q: Does it create subtitles from a video automatically?
faq.a: No. It is a manual builder: you type each time and line. For automatic subtitles, Audio to Text sends a recording to OpenAI Whisper and offers .srt and .vtt downloads with the timings already set.

faq.q: Can I type times without hours?
faq.a: Yes: HH:MM:SS, MM:SS and plain seconds up to 59 all work, with up to three decimals after a dot or a comma. Seconds above 59, and minutes above 59 in HH:MM:SS, are refused with the row number; in MM:SS form, 75:00 is read as one hour and fifteen minutes.

faq.q: Can a subtitle have two lines?
faq.a: No. Each row has a single-line text field, so every cue holds one line of text. Split a long sentence over two rows with consecutive times instead.

faq.q: Are the lines put in order?
faq.a: Yes. Rows can be typed in any order; the files list them by start time and number the SRT cues from 1. Rows with no text are left out.

tips: Play your video in Media Player next to this page to read the times, then load the finished .srt there to check it.

about.heading: About Video Compressor
about.text: Video Compressor makes a video file lighter by encoding it again as an MP4. You choose one of three compression levels, the codec (H.264, which plays on almost every device, or H.265 and AV1, which give smaller files but need a recent phone, computer or browser) and, if you want, a maximum height from 1440p down to 240p. It takes MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, WMV, FLV, MPG, TS, 3GP and other video files that have a picture track. ffmpeg does the encoding on our video service, so your browser only sends the file and receives the result. It does not cut or crop: use Video Trimmer or Video Resizer for that.

howto: Choose or drop a video file; the settings appear once it is loaded.
Pick a "Compression level" ("Balanced" is selected first) and, if you want, a "Resolution" limit.
Keep "Codec" on H.264 for a file that plays everywhere, or choose H.265 or AV1 for a smaller one; a number in "Exact quality (CRF), optional" replaces the level.
Click "Compress Video" and follow the upload, the waiting line when the service is busy, and the encoding percentage.
Compare the "Before" and "After" sizes, play the result and click "Download" to save the MP4.
